CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFSET

CFSET assigns the result of an expression to a variable, creating the variable if it does not exist yet. It is the workhorse of CFML: strings, numbers, dates, arrays, structures and query cells are all set this way.

Category

Variable manipulation

Syntax

<CFSET variable_name = expression>

Usage

The right-hand side is a CFML expression, so you do not need pound signs: write <CFSET Total = Price * Qty>, not <CFSET Total = #Price# * #Qty#>. Pound signs are only needed inside quoted strings, as in <CFSET Greeting = "Hello, #FirstName#">.

Without a scope prefix the variable goes into the local Variables scope. Prefix it to set something else: Session.Cart, Application.Title, Client.LastVisit, Request.Started. Dotted names create the structures on the way, so <CFSET Order.Ship.Zip = "02139"> builds two nested structures.

If you quote the name, it is evaluated first, which gives you dynamic variable names: <CFSET "Row#i#" = "x">. SetVariable does the same from a function call.

A CFSET without an equals sign simply evaluates the expression and throws the result away, handy for functions you call for their side effects: <CFSET ArrayAppend(Cart, "Modem")>.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Simple values, a dynamic name, a structure and an array --->
<CFSET Product = "US Robotics 56K Modem">
<CFSET Price = 129.95>
<CFSET Qty = 3>
<CFSET Total = Price * Qty>
<CFSET Ordered = CreateDate(1999, 11, 30)>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="3">
  <CFSET "Box#i#" = "Carton " & i & " of 3">
</CFLOOP>
<CFSET Customer = StructNew()>
<CFSET Customer.Name = "Carol Reardon">
<CFSET Customer.Ship.City = "Boston">
<CFSET Extras = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Extras[1] = "Phone cable">
<CFSET ArrayAppend(Extras, "Mouse pad")>

<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH ALIGN="LEFT">Variable</TH><TH ALIGN="LEFT">Value</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>Product</TD><TD>#Product#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Total (Price * Qty)</TD><TD>#DollarFormat(Total)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Ordered</TD><TD>#DateFormat(Ordered, "mmmm d, yyyy")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Box1 .. Box3</TD><TD>#Box1#; #Box2#; #Box3#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Customer.Name</TD><TD>#Customer.Name#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Customer.Ship.City</TD><TD>#Customer.Ship.City#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Extras</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Extras, ", ")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
